basis: MADS TF triggering PCD of nucellus and nucellar projection (Yin & Xue 2012 Plant Cell)
validation: in situ / GUS: preferentially expressed in nucellus and nucellar projection; RNAi blocks nucellus PCD, shrunken seeds

basis: Cell-wall invertase for carbon unloading in grain filling; gif1 poorly filled grains (Wang et al. 2008 Nat Genet)
validation: promoter-GUS: restricted to the ovular vascular trace at 3-5 DAP, plus lateral stylar trace at 10 DAP

basis: NF-Y TF regulating nutrient transport for grain filling; RNAi chalky small grains (Xu et al. 2016 J Exp Bot)
validation: in situ / reporter: specifically expressed in aleurone layer of developing endosperm; nuclear in aleurone cells

basis: bHLH activator of proanthocyanidin in pericarp (Sweeney et al. 2006 Plant Cell)
validation: mutant phenotype: rc 14-bp deletion gives white pericarp; expression by RT-PCR only

basis: KNOX homeobox, SAM marker in rice embryogenesis (Sato et al. 1996 PNAS)
validation: in situ: OSH1 marks presumptive shoot apical region of the globular embryo before organ differentiation

basis: WUS-type homeobox (WOX5 ortholog) specifically expressed in rice QC (Kamiya et al. 2003 Plant J)
validation: QHB promoter-GUS and in situ in central QC cells of radicle and crown roots (Kamiya 2003); overexpression phenotype only

basis: LBD TF required for crown root initiation, direct ARF target (Inukai et al. 2005 Plant Cell)
validation: in situ at crown and LR initiation sites overlapping DR5-GUS; crl1 lacks crown roots, fewer LR (Inukai 2005)

basis: WOX TF activating crown root emergence and growth (Zhao et al. 2009 Plant Cell)
validation: promoter-GUS/in situ in emerging crown root primordia then meristem; wox11 fewer crown roots (Zhao 2009)

basis: Sucrose transporter for phloem (re)loading along the long-distance pathway (Scofield et al. 2007 J Exp Bot)
validation: promoter-GUS largely in companion cells, protein in SE and CC (Scofield 2007)

basis: HD-Zip TF marking and promoting procambial fate commitment (Scarpella et al. 2000 Development)
validation: in situ: precise onset in early provascular cells; ectopic expression accelerates procambial commitment (Scarpella 2000)

basis: [Xylem parenchyma (stele parenchyma around vessels)] Na+ transporter retrieving Na+ from xylem (Ren et al. 2005 Nat Genet)
validation: in situ: preferentially in parenchyma cells surrounding xylem vessels; Na+-selective transport, QTL for salt tolerance (Ren 2005)

basis: [Exodermis + endodermis (distal PM)] Silicic acid influx channel at both Casparian-strip layers (Ma et al. 2006 Nature)
validation: immunostaining: distal-side plasma membrane of exodermis and endodermis; RNAi reduces Si uptake

basis: [Exodermis + endodermis (proximal PM)] Si efflux transporter paired with Lsi1 (Ma et al. 2007 Nature)
validation: immunostaining: proximal side of exodermis and endodermis cells; lsi2 mutant low Si

basis: [Exodermis + endodermis (distal PM)] Major Mn/Cd uptake transporter (Sasaki et al. 2012 Plant Cell)
validation: immunostaining: polar distal localization in exodermis and endodermis; knockout loses Mn/Cd uptake

basis: [Exodermis (hypodermis, suberized)] ABC transporter required for exodermal suberization (Shiono et al. 2014 Plant J); induction-dependent
validation: expression increased in hypodermal (exodermal) and some endodermal cells under stagnant conditions; rcn1 lacks hypodermal suberin barrier

basis: Casparian strip formation at rice endodermis (Wang et al. 2019 Plant Cell)
validation: OsCASP1 protein localized at endodermal Casparian strip domain; knockout lacks endodermal CS

basis: [Endodermis (root tip)] MYB36 orthologs regulating OsCASP1/OsESB1 (Wang et al. 2022 Plant Cell)
validation: redundant with MYB36b/c; triple mutant lacks endodermal CS; expressed in root tips

basis: [Endodermis (+CEI)] SCR ortholog marking endodermis in rice root (Kamiya et al. 2003 Plant J)
validation: in situ hybridization: endodermal layer, down in daughter cortex cell after CEI division

basis: [Trichoblast (root hair cell)] Cellulose synthase-like D for root hair elongation, KOJAK ortholog (Kim et al. 2007 Plant Physiol)
validation: gene trap and in situ: expressed only in root hair cells; csld1 hairs kinked/short

basis: [Trichoblast (root hair cell)] Grass root-hair beta-expansin with RHE motifs (Won et al. 2010 Mol Cells)
validation: promoter-GFP root-hair-specific in rice (RHE-dependent)

basis: Rice LIGULELESS1 SBP TF that builds the blade-sheath boundary organs (Lee et al. 2007 Plant Mol Biol)
validation: promoter-GUS: developing laminar joint, weakly in ligule and auricle; T-DNA mutants lack auricle, ligule and laminar joint

basis: Glabrous Rice 1, a WOX homeodomain gene required for trichome development (Li et al. 2012 Rice)
validation: map-based cloning, complementation and RNAi: loss reduces trichomes on leaves and glumes; no cell-resolution expression shown

basis: [Meristem central zone (stem cells)] Rice CLV3 ortholog restricting stem cells in reproductive meristems (Suzaki et al. 2006 Plant Cell Physiol)
validation: RNA in situ in apical stem-cell region of inflorescence and floral meristems; fon2 enlarged floral meristem and extra organs

basis: [Axillary meristem (boundary of new AM, panicle)] Rice BA1 ortholog required for AM formation in the panicle (Komatsu et al. 2003 PNAS)
validation: RNA in situ in 1-3 cell layers at the boundary between IM and new branch/spikelet AMs; lax1 lacks lateral spikelets/branches

basis: [Axillary meristem (tiller bud)] LAS ortholog required for tiller AM initiation and outgrowth (Li et al. 2003 Nature); RAP ID per Oryzabase (UniProt lists Os06g0610300)
validation: RNA in situ in leaf axils and axillary buds; moc1 monoculm (no tillers)

basis: [Axillary meristem (premeristem zone)] WUS ortholog required for AM formation in rice (Tanaka et al. 2015 Plant Cell)
validation: RNA in situ in premeristem zone of forming AMs, not in SAM; tab1 lacks tillers and panicle AMs

basis: ALOG TF promoting IM/BM indeterminacy (Yoshida et al. 2013 PNAS)
validation: RNA in situ in shoot apex, inflorescence and branch meristems, down in spikelet meristems; gain-of-function prolongs branch meristem activity

basis: ERF TF establishing floral meristem identity in spikelets (Komatsu et al. 2003 Development)
validation: RNA in situ in spikelet meristem / rudimentary glume boundary; fzp makes branches instead of florets

basis: [Lodicule (and stamen)] B-class AP3 ortholog specifying lodicule identity (Nagasawa et al. 2003 Development)
validation: RNA in situ in lodicule and stamen primordia; spw1 lodicules become palea-like, stamens become carpels

basis: [Palea (marginal region) and lodicule] AGL6-like MADS gene for palea margin and lodicule identity (Ohmori et al. 2009 Plant Cell)
validation: RNA in situ in palea margins, lodicules, carpel and ovule; mfo1 palea marginal region and lodicules lose identity

basis: CYC-like TCP gene controlling palea development (Yuan et al. 2009 Plant Physiol)
validation: RNA in situ in palea primordia early, later stamens/vasculature; rep1 palea retarded and floral symmetry altered

basis: SEP-like MADS gene specifying lemma/palea identity (Jeon et al. 2000 Plant Cell)
validation: RNA in situ in lemma and palea (and inner floret); lhs1 leafy lemma/palea

basis: [Sterile lemma (empty glume)] ALOG gene specifying sterile lemma identity (Yoshida et al. 2009 PNAS)
validation: RNA in situ in sterile lemma primordia; g1 converts sterile lemmas to lemma-like organs; glume homology across Triticeae uncertain

basis: bHLH TF for tapetum degeneration (Li et al. 2006 Plant Cell)
validation: RNA in situ in tapetum; tdr delays tapetum PCD, male sterile
